_comment: EXISTING wire shape of GET /api/v1/management/system/license/status (PlatformAdminOnly; ManagementSystemEndpoints.cs GetLicenseStatus returns the Pro LicenseStatusSnapshot as-is, serialized by Platform's ApiJsonContext with UseStringEnumConverter = true; generated type components['schemas']['LicenseStatusSnapshot'], every field optional on the wire). v2 supersedes licensed-agent-metering's license-status-snapshot.v1.json in ONE respect only: the set of `tier` values. After this change `tier` is exactly one of None | Developer | SelfHostStartup | SelfHostBusiness | WhiteLabel. SaaSBusiness and SaaSEnterprise are retired (verbara-meta/PDR-0006); their integers 4 and 5 are never reused, and `tier` is never the number 4 or 5 nor the strings "4" or "5": a licence whose signed Tier is not a defined LicenseTier member fails validation and is reported with tier None. No field is added, renamed or removed; maxAgents stays the advisory licensed-agent band (null or 0 = not declared); licensee is the licensee name and is NOT the tier. A console that meets a tier value outside the set (an older Platform before the pin bump) renders it as received. Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names and tier values VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).
